text: In ZFC, why can't we form the 'set of all sets'?
choices: Because the Axiom of Foundation forbids it
Because unrestricted comprehension leads to paradox — ZFC uses the Axiom Schema of Separation instead
Because the Axiom of Choice is needed first
explanation: The Axiom Schema of Separation (Aussonderung) restricts comprehension to subsets of an existing set, avoiding Russell's paradox.
